# AI jingle ad with a singing product mascot — Lyria 3.5 and Seedance 2.5

**A product photo becomes a clay, plush or 3D mascot that sings a 15–30 s brand jingle, with lyric captions and a real end card.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_0052df2b0599.webp" alt="A clay-style pet nail clipper mascot with googly eyes sings its jingle in a pastel room." width="480"></p>

Turns a product into a singing mascot ad on varg: the product itself as a claymation, plush or 3D-family-film character with a face built for lip-sync, a 15-30 s jingle with the brand name in the hook (Lyria 3.5 with timed lyric sections, trimmed to length), the mascot singing it on Seedance 2.5 with the song as an audio reference, the master song laid back on top, lyric captions and a real product end card. Non-human ads skip the "fake person" problem, get shared and suit dropshipping products. Use when a seller asks for a jingle ad, a singing product, a mascot ad, a claymation or cartoon product video, a song ad for TikTok or Reels, or a talking product character. Not for full music videos for songs (varg-music-video), human UGC actors (ai-ugc-ad-video), or original characters without a product (varg-character-absurd).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-mascot-jingle-ad                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-mascot-jingle-ad --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 73 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | 15–30 s singing mascot ad MP4 |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Typical cost | ~$5.78 per 15 s singing clip, ~$0.10 per jingle (tested) |
| Uses | varg API, Nano Banana 2.1, Lyria 3.5, Seedance 2.5, Whisper, FFmpeg |
| Works in | Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other Agent Skills tools |
| Agent instructions | [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) (v1.0.0) |

- "Make a plush version of our coffee tin that sings the brand name twice, for Reels"
